staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Edit nicks and roles as shown on the site, or hide members. Bot data is never modified.
staff.searchPlaceholder: Search by nick, role or ID

edit.title: Edit member
edit.description: Changes go live on the public site when saved.
edit.notice: The bot syncs staff from Discord: edits made here are stored as a layer on top and survive the next sync. Use “Reset” to go back to the bot value.

hide.title: Hide {{nick}}?
hide.description: They will no longer appear on the staff page or their profile. You can restore them anytime.

profile.title: Public profile
profile.description: Shown on the /staff-navy card. Enter only the username for each network, not the URL.
profile.autoHint_one: Automatic shows “{{status}}” ({{count}} test in the last 30 days).
profile.autoHint_other: Automatic shows “{{status}}” ({{count}} tests in the last 30 days).
profile.autoHintNoTester: Automatic shows no status because they haven't run any tests.
profile.namemcHint: Automatic link to their NameMC profile using their nick.

testers.title: Testers
testers.description: Testers in the /top-testers ranking. Give retired testers a nick or remove them from the ranking; the bot's tests are not changed.
testers.searchPlaceholder: Search by nick, role or Discord ID

edit.title: Edit tester
edit.description: The nick is used on /top-testers for the skin and name.
edit.noDetected: No nick detected: shown as “Retired tester”.
edit.notice: Discord ID: {{id}}. Leave the field empty to go back to the detected nick.

hide.title: Hide {{nick}}?
hide.description: They will no longer appear on /top-testers in any period. You can restore them at any time.

bans.title: Bans
bans.description: Fix nicks, reasons or duration of public bans, or hide the ones that should not be shown.
bans.searchPlaceholder: Search by nick, uuid or reason

edit.title: Edit ban #{{id}}
edit.description: Changes go live on the public site when saved.
edit.notice: The bot's original ban is not modified: changes are stored as a layer on top. Use “Reset” to go back to the bot value.

hide.title: Hide ban #{{id}}?
hide.description: It will no longer be shown on the bans page or the player's profile. You can restore it anytime.

users.title: Users
users.description: Tierlist players. Fix their nick or remove them from the ranking without deleting their results.

edit.title: Edit player
edit.description: The nick is updated in tierlist, ranking and profile.
edit.notice: Test results are not modified. Leave the field empty or use “Reset” to go back to the bot nick.

hide.title: Hide {{nick}} from the ranking?
hide.description: They will no longer appear in the tierlist, ranking, latest results or profile search, and positions are recalculated. Their results are kept and you can restore them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Maintenance tools for the public site.

revalidate.title: Refresh pages
revalidate.description: Staff and bans are regenerated every 24 h. Force an update to see changes instantly.

cache.title: API cache
cache.description: Responses cached in the database to lighten heavy queries.
cache.confirmDescription: All “{{group}}” entries will be deleted. They are rebuilt on the next visit.
cache.protectedNote: The applications anti-spam protection is never purged from here.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.description: Every change made from the panel is logged with its previous value.
